text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (I still hate bothersome things.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So cold... damn. I mean, the stars are 
still out. Ah~ I should've worn more 
layers underneath.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Still, going home is kinda a pain too, 
huh~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Oh boy.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(...Personally, I really think you're 
letting yourself go to waste.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(I mean, you're super smart, and you can 
come up with crazy good strategies, 
right?)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (...Still, you know...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa. That was close.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Taping, taping. And for the nails...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Mm. Heheh, your form's as pretty as ever. 
Alright, one more set.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And across the goal... we go.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Damn. Wasn't that a new record? I'm on 
fire~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Beep beep beep...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... That was close! School's about to 
start!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Take a shower, do my makeup— Ooh, let's 
try out my new mascara~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well then, guess I'll head home~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Bakushin bakushiiin.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(I'm stupid, y'know? I can only do what 
I'm told, but...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(I did what I was told, so it seems like 
my legs might remember some of it.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(That's why. Because I'm someone like 
this...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
――Can't I become that "amazing Umamusume" 
you talked about?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
'Sup~. Trainer, look, look! I tried a 
brand-new set of nail tips. Cute, right?
choice_data_list: Your hooves look nice and healthy.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, they're super tough, so you can 
stick tape on 'em tight~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's all you have to say~? Aren't 
you being way too stiff~?
choice_data_list: Besides, I think it's really beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Riiight~? How can you not get hyped? 
That's what I'm talkin' about~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Alrighty, off I go~.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is your Umamusume... really running 
in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)?

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, then make me train more seriously. 
The lineup for this Tenno Sho (Autumn) is 
terrifying, you know?

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text:
It's a rematch among an all-star lineup. 
And Derby winner Eishin Flash is coming 
too, right?

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, a top contender who recently made 
her comeback is also coming... This is 
shaping up to be an absolute dream match."

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Your classmates are already making huge 
strides as it is. Hey, did you hear about 
Nakayama Festa? You two need to get 
serious, too—"

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, keeping the main race in mind, 
though...
choice_data_list:
And on race day, she'll put in a run no 
one can beat.

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...Were you always this obsessed with 
your trainee?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, we're a pair of fools.
Yeah, we're a pair of idiots.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! My throat's super parched, you 
know!
choice_data_list:
Break time, then! At least come get some 
water!

Break time, then! At least come get some 
water!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー!? Stingyー! You could've just 
brought it for me, you know.

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, haha. I see. Still, you make a 
fine pair.

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Jordan, are you really running the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn)?! Isn't that crazy!?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
A bunch of amazing Umamusume are 
gathering, right? And so Jordan is—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Besides, I'm gonna win anyway, right?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: SO COOLLLL~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ! Palmer! Well, that felt pretty good.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's totally working, totally 
working~☆ Trainer, you're doing great too!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Duh, obviously~? The Aki-Ten is right 
around the corner, right? So...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...So be sure to come watch the real 
race. I'm gonna run faster than anyone 
else out there."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'll show ya running like you've never 
seen before.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. You're raising the bar for yourself 
there."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's fine. ...Because...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I'd hate it even more if you missed the 
moment I become the strongest!"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
We will now move on to the Q&A portion of 
the joint press conference for the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn) runners.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Jordan-san! May I have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Recently, Nakayama Festa achieved an 
incredible feat by placing 2nd in France! 
As her classmate—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's really amazing. Nakayama, too. 
That really surprised me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
“This is where my race is. This is where 
I'm gonna become the strongest.”

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"The strongest... Does that mean you will 
definitely defeat every member in this 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah. No, as for me...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Not just among these Umamusume, either. 
I'm gonna be the strongest out of all of 
'em in history.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek?! So you're aiming for a new record? 
Well, um, according to the data~... Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Do you think it's impossible for 
someone like me to aim for that?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Umm... that is...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"You can laugh if you want. Even I know 
I'm saying something completely 
ridiculous."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Still, though... there are people who 
genuinely cheer me on.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Then we've got no choice but to do it. No 
matter how stupid we think it is.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... That's why you gotta write it real 
big in newspapers and magazines, ya hear?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"They told me I'm the ultimate idiot... 
and an Umamusume destined to make it big!"
